subject: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners

Team —

Quick kickoff note to align on the SKU/region packaging we want to publish across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and who will lead the co-sell enablement for each cloud. I attached a first-pass SKU matrix (sku_matrix_v1.xlsx) with suggestions; comments inline would be great.

High-level constraints that drove the draft:
- We want at least one evergreen subscription SKU and one metered/consumption SKU per cloud for GA.
- Region coverage should match initial sales targets: US (primary), EU (GDPR customers), APAC (large telco prospects).
- Azure requires a managed offer for co-sell approval; AWS prefers an AMI + SaaS listing; GCP favors a private SaaS listing for marketplace partners.

Asks for EOW (Friday):
- Karthik: confirm SKU names and pricing bands per cloud in the spreadsheet.
- Jonas: own the EU data residency messaging and verify telemetry language is compatible with Azure co-sell requirements.
- Aditya: sync with partner contacts and confirm co-sell onboarding timeline (hubSpot deal MP-9987).

I'll coordinate legal for the terms we need to include, but want concrete SKU/region decisions first so we can start intake with partner teams.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners

Marissa — thanks for the draft. Quick comments after a pass through the matrix:

1) SKU naming: propose short names for marketplace display (limit 30 chars):
   - Redwood Inference — Starter (monthly subscription)
   - Redwood Inference — Scale (annual + reserved)
   - Redwood Inference — Metered (pay-as-you-go, token-based)

2) Pricing bands: keep parity across clouds where possible but allow +/-10% for marketplace fees and channel discounts. I'll add suggested bands to sku_matrix_v1.

3) Region specifics:
   - AWS: list in us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 for GA. Add ap-southeast-1 for APAC quarter 2.
   - Azure: publish in East US, West Europe, Southeast Asia (note: West Europe required for partner co-sell in EU).
   - GCP: publish in us-central1, europe-west1, asia-southeast1.

I'll upload an updated sheet by EOD Thursday.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners

Karthik / Marissa — noted. A couple of nuances on Azure co-sell we need to bake in:

- Managed offer: Azure will require a managed application or private SaaS offer to qualify for co-sell. That means we have to submit the offer with the right telemetry and partner legal agreements.
- Data residency blurb: For EU customers we'll state: "Customer data is processed within the selected Azure region; Redwood does not export customer content without consent." Need legal to sign off but good enough for the marketplace copy.
- Metered SKU: Azure meter definitions are more prescriptive — we should use a token-minute metric similar to our internal billing to simplify mapping.

I'll draft the public marketplace copy for the EU SKUs and share a redline.

-Jonas
Director, Product Partnerships

---

From: Samantha Li <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners

Marissa/Karthik — great to meet you. AWS partner team here — happy to help accelerate the listing. A couple notes from our side:

- For fastest onboarding into the AWS marketplace co-sell program, publish both an AMI-backed product (for customers wanting self-managed) and a SaaS listing (for hosted). We can attach co-sell leads to either.
- Billing model: metered SaaS is supported but ensure you provide the usage API endpoint and sample payload for validation.
- Regions: US-EAST-1 + EU-WEST-1 is sufficient to start. We can mirror other regions later.

I'll loop in our partner engineer if you want us to review the SKU matrix live next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
AWS Partner Sales
aws-partner-team@amazon.com

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / Region matrix + co-sell owners

Samantha — thanks, that matches our plan. Quick update for the team:

- I attached the co-sell checklist (redwood_co-sell_checklist.pdf) with next steps for AWS/Azure/GCP intake, owner names, and estimated lead times.
- Owners: AWS co-sell runbook -> Samantha (AWS), internal owner -> Aditya Rao; Azure co-sell -> Ravi Menon (cc'd earlier), internal owner -> Jonas Weber; GCP -> Priya Nair, internal owner -> Karthik Iyer.
- Intake timeline: submit drafts to each partner by July 7; expect validation calls the week of July 14.

Action items captured in the sheet and checklist. If no objections, I'll start the partner intake forms tomorrow and schedule the AWS review call for July 8.

-Aditya
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced:
- sku_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: suggested SKUs, pricing bands, region checklist)
- redwood_co-sell_checklist.pdf (PDF: steps and owners for each cloud intake)

Quoted-originals preserved in thread.
